Representative planes: exterior walls on their observed outer faces (thickness 240, labelled '240' on plan); interior partitions on measured line-pair midplanes, drawn ~120 thick. Exterior opening positions from the facade dimension chains (they sum to 10000/20000 on all four facades and match the drawn jambs within ~1 px); interior partition and door positions from pixel measurement (about +-30 mm). World y = north, x = east; z absolute, ground floor at 0.
